selection.summary: Fix for #1241: the opt parser (zstd_opt.c) and its internal helpers initialize the first match index / lowest match reference to 0, which can make the first input position appear as a valid match during first use of the context. The fix starts the reference at 1. Evidence: h0 and h14 show zstd_opt.c match index loops and lowest-position handling; h12, h13, h15, h17 and h24 show zstd_compress_internal.h definitions of lowest match index / context window base where the reference initialization (currently 0, to be changed to 1) lives.

selection_posture: Exact terminal packet and response over independently receipt-bound branch evidence; explicit selected handles only.
